anchor: Sweep bar close weighted by its observed OANDA price-update count; include sweep bar through confirmation bar (six bars). Anchor is only published after the sweep closes. No backdating.

arms.anchored_activity: Same sweep direction; trade only if side*(close-event anchored price)>0 and vol_ratio_5_20>0.
arms.long: LONG at each shared sweep opportunity; FLAT is zero on the same population.
arms.rolling_activity: Same sweep direction; trade only if side*(close-rolling20 close*volume/sum(volume))>0 and vol_ratio_5_20>0.
arms.sweep: Every qualified one-sided sweep at identical five-bar confirmation time.

decision: GO only if all eight primary s1 mean_net_bps endpoints (four baselines x two funding modes) have simultaneous lower bound above1 bps and positive solvent later-period risk-scaled economics. Any required upper bound below1 is NO_GO; otherwise INKONKLUSIV. GO permits proposal of fresh confirmation research only.
entry_clock: Confirmation bar start+5min, first actual open at or after decision. Scheduled diagnostic exit decision+60min, first actual open thereafter. Expired entries remain counted; terminal positions liquidated at last pre-2026 close with costs.
event_owner: compute_smc_features(include_v30_additions=True), default SWING_LOOKBACK=3 and one-shot confirmed pivot identities; up sweep fades SHORT, down sweep fades LONG; double events create no candidate.
hypothesis: A confirmed one-sided M5 sweep, followed by five closed contiguous bars, has higher net opportunity value when fade-direction close is beyond event-anchored quote-activity VWAP and vol_ratio_5_20>0.
inference_family: 96 simultaneous later-period endpoints: anchored_activity minus sweep/rolling_activity/LONG/FLAT, four slippage scenarios, two financing scenarios, raw opportunity bps/ATR-normalized bps/calendar-day Sharpe. One frozen rule; no scan.
invalidation: Any intervening one- or two-sided sweep event invalidates the old candidate before its confirmation. Any missing M5 bar between event and confirmation invalidates candidate. Both are known at decision.
limitations: OANDA volume counts price updates, not executed contracts. AVWAP is a quote-activity-weighted close proxy, not transaction VWAP.
Fixed five-bar confirmation and twelve-bar measurement horizon are one preregistered hypothesis, not native Entry/Exit rules or parameter optima.
Baseline is the same sweep opportunity policy and existing rolling-VWAP primitive, not a trained current native policy.
No Dukascopy economic transfer claim: sparse local cache is structurally audited separately, has no download receipts and is not admitted.
No untouched later holdout is established; 2021-2025 was used in prior project research. TEST remains sealed.
EFFR plus1.29pp is an existing research financing proxy, not verified historical OANDA swaps; zero financing is co-primary.
Observed bid/ask plus0/0.5/1/2bps per execution; no queue position, guaranteed execution or impact claim.
All opportunities including filtered zeros and censored terminal positions remain counted. No dependence-based sample inflation.
Yearly and2011-2020 results are descriptive; joint inference and decision use2021-2025 only.
No parameter fits, native model change, training, live/paper or spending.
operator_authorization: User accepted the proposed bounded Dukascopy audit and separate sweep/anchored VWAP/activity test: ja gjør dette.
population_classification: 2011-2020 descriptive history; 2021-2025 fixed later primary period. All reused development history, never untouched holdout. No fitted parameters or selection based on new outcomes.
selection: One shared nonoverlapping reservation cohort chosen by sweep-only rule, through actual exit quote. Rejected filters stay with zero PnL and still reserve the slot; no per-arm resampling.
